reason: It puts everything in a Google Sheet, but my work lives in Jurnal and Accurate, so I would still be retyping or importing every row by hand. I might forward a few nota to the free tier out of curiosity, but I would not pay for another sheet to clean up.
objection: My clients will not want a bot in their group chats, and even if they did, the data stops in Google Sheets instead of my accounting system. I also doubt it reads the crumpled, handwritten nota my clients actually send.
would_change_my_mind: A direct export or ready-made import file for Jurnal and Accurate, so I can forward the receipts myself without adding the bot to my clients' chats.
